changelog: Coordinate primary Google Sheets and backup feeds with one run_id, a 30-minute deadline, and a permanently latched source lane.
Validate the L:Q Sheet completion protocol and stop cleanly with NO_NEW_CONTENT instead of rendering stale or already-published news.
Prevent duplicate Telegram, Facebook Page, and Facebook Group delivery with SQLite leases, per-destination claims, and audited recovery.
Add headless scheduled, status, review-resolution, and controlled publish-retry commands with atomic run-scoped artifacts.
Standardize the production schedule at 07:15 and 19:15 Asia/Bangkok and bundle both source masters plus Playwright Chromium.
